title: Where Bechet lived and his first trip back in twenty years
summary: He lists Bechet's addresses and says his brother only became proud of him after Laurent hosted him on that first return visit.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Where did Bichet live when you were a boy?

On Oakwood Street, yeah. He lived on Monroir Street. Then they moved to, his brother moved to St. Menard Street, but his brother got rid of him then. He moved to St. Menard and Moray. And from St. Menard and Moray he moved to St. Menard and Villaray.
His brother of course was always proud of him in the late years. Yes, in the late years.

But no, you know when he got proud of him? When I picked him up at the airport and brought him to my house. After that, yeah. Then his brother came up to the house and had supper with him that night. That's when he started to begin to work. But I'm the one picking him up at the airport. That's his first trip back here in twenty some years.
It was during the war, was it during the war? Huh? Was that during the war or when was that?
That's his first trip back to New Orleans.
